reviews.text:
BEST VET place for our 4 legged friends.
Thru out the years this has been a place we can trust.
Dr. Martinez and especially  Dr. Zouain are compassionate and best in their field.

If you love your dog, don't take it to this clinic. My dog ​​Mia died, and if she had received the correct treatment, she would be alive today. These people diagnosed her with a stomach infection and put her on a treatment supposedly for a week, but that treatment lasted 22 days because her fever wouldn't go down.
By the way, the treatment was very expensive. One day, after so much vomiting, I took her to another clinic in an emergency, and my beloved pet didn't have a stomach infection; it was pancreatic cancer. If we had given her the correct treatment, she would be alive today. Rest in peace, Mia Lee Delgado. Think twice before taking your pet to this place.

I NEVER write reviews but I absolutely have to write one on this place. I’m going to share my experience and who ever is considering to bring their pet please reconsider. My 1 year old cane corso which was VERY healthy never showed any signs of anything was brought here to get his vaccines, upon arrival they sold us on testing him for worms and stated he had worms in his poop. To not be concerned because it’s normal just give him the medication they prescribed and everything would be fine. At no point did they inform us of any side affects of the medication but instead were focused on selling everything they possibly could to raise our bill and since we LOVE our dog we decided to do what a educated veterinarian suggest atleast that’s what we thought. Our dog has now had diarreah since being brought here a week ago with blood and when I call and ask for answers or explanations they state he would need another evaluation meaning another charge for them to tell us what it is after spending almost 800 the week prior. No vet wanted to speak in person only the girls in the front that are incredibly un helpful and looked at me dumbfounded one gave me different information over the phone and then I was told a different price in person. They  tried to sell me on dog food and a medication only for his pooping. If you are someone who works hard for your money, LOVES your pet DO NOT BRING them here. Please do more research I can assure you there are several other places that will attend your pets and care about the wellbeing of your pets instead of charging you more. Thank you.
Excellent care and attention

My experience at Muller Animal Hospital was excellent. We always take our cat Misifu there, and he receives the best care. This time, we took a kitten named Cuquito; he's not ours, but he's like one of our own. The attention from all the staff, and especially from Dr. Emilio, was the best. The doctor operated on the kitten and took the time to explain the surgery to me. I am very grateful to him and all the staff.

Unfortunately, this was the worst clinic I've ever been to. We had to come in for an emergency, and our cat almost died on the examination table because there was no care. All the staff were gossiping about their lives behind the door. By the way, congratulations to the woman who's going to be a grandmother! There was no shortage of laughter. We left because they never attended to us in the room.

I have been a loyal client of this animal hospital for over 20 years, trusting them with the care of our multiple pets throughout the years. But today, I was deeply disappointed by how my sick dog and I were treated.

I took my dog Hunter with severe diarrhea and despite the urgency and the decades of loyalty I've shown, I was told they wouldn't see him because they "don't take emergencies." There was no effort to assess the situation, no compassion, and just a cold referral elsewhere.  I'm sure it didn't go past beyond the reception desk, because I wasn't able to talk to any vet, but it was still disappointing in a moment of stress and worry. I wasn't asking for special treatment--I was asking for help from a place I thought cared about its patients.

I understand policies and limitations, but to turn away a sick animal, who is already there, especially one they've treated for years, is unacceptable. Emergencies don't happen on a schedule. The lack of empathy and unwillingness to even try to help was shocking.

Over the last 20 years, we've trusted them with the care of every animal we've had--spending THOUSANDS of dollars on routine visits, medications, surgeries, and treatments. We never hesitated because we believed they truly cared. After two decades, I will no longer be bringing my three pups here. They've never had a problem taking my money but if you're looking for a place that will be there when it really matters--this isn't it.

EDIT:
Thank you for your response. After being a loyal client for 20 years, I expected a more compassionate and personalized experience rather than a canned, customer service reply. I understand that you are not an emergency clinic, but the lack of empathy, communication, and willingness to help in a dire moment  for a patient, I hope will warn all potential new clients to avoid this place.
Your response only reassures me that I made the right choice for myself and my pets. I hope other people reading will learn from my experience: RUN don’t walk away from this place!
Excellent service, everyone was very friendly, and the doctor was super kind, polite, and competent.

Unprofessional and liars I paid a lot of money for them to just give me back my animal and say he was fine when he was not fine and was exactly the same way when I gave him to them I had to take him to a different vet and he ended up having to get surgery because of their neglect towards him

Very disappointing experience.

I brought my dog in for a cytology test to check for possible cancer and signed the estimate they gave me. After they already took the sample, they suddenly said there was a pricing “mistake” and increased the cost from $40 to $180.

When I didn’t agree to the new price, they refused to send the sample to the lab even though the procedure had already been done. So my dog went through it for nothing, and I left without answers.

I still ended up paying over $1,200, and the main test wasn’t even completed due to their error.The doctor was unprofessional and unfair. I would be cautious coming here.

Not worse the visit!!
Two 81 year old customers had approached the counter!!

And they said  “Had a Seat” for 1.5 hour without any help!!!!

Them they asked,  why we had not being helped?

Uhhh.. no we only work with appointments!!

This is what this vet do t elderly people!!!!

I had an appointment on March 10, 2026 with Dr. Samuel Vasallo. His team provided excellent service, the staff at the front desk were very friendly, and the prices are good. This is the second time I've taken my Chihuahua there, and I'm very pleased.

I want to thank the entire team at this place, and especially Emilio, for all the love, affection, and respect they showed us during the loss of my beloved dog. It was an incredibly difficult time, but they had so much love to give. Thank you all (Emilio, that love makes you special). Thank you to all the staff for so much love. Many blessings 😭😭😭 01-29-2016 My son Frosty is in heaven

I've been a client of Dr. Emilio for over 20 years. He's treated all my dogs. Unfortunately, I've had to leave the clinic because of their terrible staff. I've been trying to make an appointment for two weeks, and all I've received are rude replies and a very bad attitude. They told me to come back today, and when I arrived, the three women were already there at 9:00 AM, and none of them wanted to help because they gave me the wrong appointment; Dr. Emilio wasn't there today. I asked to see the supervisor, and she told me without even looking at me that he wasn't there. I left to avoid further problems, as I lost an hour of work because of them. It's a shame that I have to leave such a great vet because of an incompetent staff who don't want to do a good job.
These guys are great! I came all the way down from NY STATE to pick up Roy! Thank-you all for everything

I don’t recommend this clinic to anyone, if you want good service and actual care for your animal take them somewhere else. My dog needed pain management, but none was offered, all they were able to offer was a ridiculously high bill for a bunch of tests that were not priority at the time , no son rápidos pa ayudar pero si pa cobrarte

Very friendly staff and vet doctors.
Easy to deal with. Chuchi my cat loves going there !
Although it is an animal hospital if it’s close to closing time they will turn you away, claiming they are not equipped for emergencies. No compasión very unprofessional and uncaring.

If you can avoid coming here do so. Waste of my time and my poor dog who has been throwing up since yesterday and is super weak. I walked in the doctor took forever to attend me. She never came to my waiting room they had me walk through the clinic in the back to see my dog all for her to not even introduce herself. (She was blonde) all she did was take my dogs temp and weigh her there wasn’t even an attempt to give me some sort of anti nausea medication absolutely nothing. she told me there was nothing she could do for me because my dog needed extra supervision she couldn’t provide because she has “a lot of other things going on”. I didn’t like her attitude or how she handled the situation. At the end
Of the day I still don’t know what’s wrong with my dog and now I have to find a different vet with better work ethic because this one is
A joke.
They dont pick up calls
Run away from this place if you love your pet. They are in 4148 E 8th Ave, Hialeah
Very kind compassionate professional.
Been going here for many years, impeccable service and quality achieved by the doctors here. They show an unmatched care for your animal unlike any other place I have been to.
Great caring staff and attention for my pets well-being. Thank you Andres for your genuine love of our furry friends.

Extraordinary Veterinary Service! The doctor was absolutely amazing caring, knowledgeable, and gentle with my dog 🐕. The staff was incredibly kind, patient, and helpful throughout the entire visit. Highly recommend this clinic!
Amazing attention to my dog. He’s a handful and not once did they make it seem like an issue. Felt right at home. Very patient and kind!
Hello, Nery. We apologize for any negative experience you may have had while at our clinic. Please feel free to give us a call or text at (305) 688-0561 if you'd like to discuss this with us.

It's a reputable clinic; I've been receiving their services for many years. They are warm and professional, even in the most difficult moments. My dog ​​Fito was cared for with great love until the very end.
I love this place. Dr. Emilio is a sweetheart and very gentle with my dog. I am very grateful for his attention.

The staff at this clinic are not only unprofessional but downright careless. My dog, who is extremely nervous, had her glands expressed, and understandably had a bowel movement during the process. Instead of handling it with any kind of compassion or basic hygiene, they shaved all around her anus and left her with painful lacerations. They also told us nothing about this. They simply said she pooped herself and they “cleaned” her. Now she’s in obvious discomfort, all because of their incompetence and lack of empathy. Do yourself a favor and find a new vet clinic literally anywhere else in Miami. Disgusting.

I have been a customer of Muller Animal Hospital for over 15 years. In this time, I've had several dogs under their care and have experienced the best care possible for my babies. First, the staff is second to none and they really care about you and your dogs. Second, Dr. Martinez is very thorough with the examination and extremely price conscious. Third, they have earned my trust when it comes to the care of my dogs. I'm really grateful to Muller and the  staff for the outstanding service all these years.
Thanks Fernando for your review!

We arrived at this clinic with an injured cat (Pachuco), who underwent jaw surgery. We are very grateful to the entire team, especially Dr. Emilio and technician José Prendes (Pepe), who dedicated a lot of their time to our case. Thanks to Dr. Emilio, we can now have our pet back with us.
Excellent doctors. I fully trust everything they suggest. I feel like my dog ​​is always well cared for by them.
Very poor service

I am surprised that Mueller Vet Clinic, after 15 years of taking our dogs to that location, today when we had one of our dog sick, they refused to evaluate and treat him with the criteria that they do not attend emergencies..... did they change the administration?, did they change the concept of giving care to a sick dog? I find it illogical... because in the past we have taken our sick dogs and they have accepted us.
We took our dog to another clinic that they don’t know us and they have the courtesy, professionalism, empathy to evaluate and treat our 🐶..
Great prices, and quality care.

Hello, I absolutely do not recommend this clinic. I waited two hours to vaccinate my pet. The person at the front desk was completely unprofessional and treated all customers very badly. It was a very unpleasant experience.
Great Customer Service Very Helpful

Hello. I've been going to this clinic for a long time, over 15 years. Yesterday, I called to pick up my pet's medication, and the employee who answered was very unpleasant, rude, and dismissive. I made that clear to her, not because of the answer she gave me, but because of the way she spoke to me. She treated me very badly. I don't know if she minds speaking Spanish or if she minds working, but I felt very mistreated. I called back to say I was on my way, and they told me not to come in because they were sending my pets' records and wouldn't be providing any more service. I wonder, who made that decision? The doctor? They didn't even listen to me; they didn't let me explain my side of the story. What kind of policy is that for treating a customer of over 15 years? What a lack of ethics and respect! From this moment on, I have the worst opinion of the staff at that place, and I do not recommend it to anyone. It's a shame that things like that happen in this country.
My appointment was at 10:20 am. My name wasn’t called until 11:45 am. I wasn’t able to leave until 1:00pm. Only come here if you plan on spending your whole day at the vet!

My mother started coming here in the 1990s and I was a teen it was the best Care, the doctors great however something changed in the management in the way they do things and it’s not the same. I do not recommend people to go there anymore. They are pretty reasonable in price, but they don’t really care for the pets If you could find another vet, please do so I will be taking all my animals somewhere else .
Thank you for the 5 star review!
The best in Town. Highly recommend...

Dr. Emilio and the team at the animal hospital are amazing! They treat our golden retriever like family—with so much care, patience, and love. I always leave feeling confident my dog is in the best hands. Highly recommend!
My family and I have been coming to Mueller‘s animal hospital for many years now and they never disappoint, with the treatment and care they provide to the animals.

Adriana Martinez, DVM is quite mean-spirited, seemingly uncompassionate medical professional I've ever had the misfortune of dealing with. I've dealt with this vet for two years and even her office manager mentioned to me (2.5 yrs ago) that they've had many problems due to the constant chip on her shoulder. I'm never taking my dog there again.
Terrible customer service.
I love the service, they are very professional.
Super friendly. Excellent service. High-quality staff and pet care.
Thank you for the 5 star review!
Hi, thank you for your review!
Hi, thank you for your review!
Excellent service as always. They treat their furry friends with love.

This company has the worst customer service and they are very expensive. The receptionists in the front desk do not great and there is one with pink hair that gave me attitude. I asked her to please not give me attitude and she replies by saying that I am giving attitude. Then when I asked to speak to the manager (Sonia), the manager also gives me attitude and denied giving me service there even though I was booked already for dog boarding. So grateful for Dr Martinez and her help over the years with my dogs heart condition. He’s doing good, very happy to see her always

Horrible place I call and ask price a puppy vaccine price and if they give paper of vaccination of the puppy when I got there the charge me more than what I has told and they didn’t want to give me any proof of paperwork of puppy vaccine taken, they did a fecal test and the guy who assist it came out negative and they prescribed my puppy a medicine for intestinal parasite that it didn’t need I demand then to give a proof of vaccination paper they created one that didn’t have any information properly and they put my puppy was prescribed a medicine and the test came out negative Horrible place and the doctor doesn’t help at all don’t take you pets here

Dr. Emilio is absolutely amazing! He always makes our fur babies feel comfortable and cared for. He is incredibly knowledgeable, compassionate, and takes the time to explain everything thoroughly. Whether it’s a routine check-up or something more serious, you can tell he genuinely loves what he does and always puts his patients first. No idea why this vet has so many positive reviews. The staff has no idea what’s going on most of the time. Got my dog spayed there, they didn’t even call me to pick her up; terrible stitching; didn’t even tell me a follow-up was needed and didn’t even mark her in any way to show she’s spayed for future reference. And this place looks condemned outside. Staff couldn’t even give proper medication instructions and after giving the receptionist my email letter per letter about 4 times over the phone I still never received my paperwork.

Highly recommend this vet to anyone looking for top-notch care for their furry friends!
Excellent
The staff is passionate about animals and patient with pet owners. Be sure to make an appointment because they are always busy. Dr. Adriana is professional and compassionate.

Highly recommend this hospital! Words can not even express how wonderful this hospital is. Each and every single staff member is absolutely wonderful from the moment you pick up the phone and speak with them, to when you see the doctor with your animal. They are kind, respectful, and look after your animal as if they are their own. I drive 45 minutes to come here. They are very reasonable with cost and the doctors don’t just try to make money of you by recommending things you don’t need. They listen and care, all staff speak Spanish AND English which I am so grateful for, unlike others… they treat you and your pet very well here. The doctors (Emilio and Sonia) are amazing with our dog, very knowledgeable and give the best medical advice! I am so glad we found this place for our fur-baby Chico, we know he is always in good hands when we bring him here.
